svg.title: CMC Pile Labels - GBL-GT-24136
svg.desc: OCR-extracted pile labels from CMC layout image. 803 of ~1075 piles identified. Coordinate system: original image pixels (4762 x 5493, 577 PPI). Text rotation: 30 deg (adjust transform if needed). Confidence: green=high(5+ angle votes), black=medium(2-4), red=low(1 vote).
